changes.before: Liquidity is becoming more dependent on the specific channel through which it reaches assets. Reuters discusses India's entry into a major emerging-market debt index. Index inclusion can change the set of investors able or required to consider a market, but it does not establish an exact amount of completed buying before that buying occurs. CNBC reports UBS seeing a return of European IPO activity outside technology. The regional and sector qualification matters: capital can be available to a particular issuer group without creating an equally favorable market for every company. Treat these as changes in the opportunity set and distribution of funding.
